anti_patterns.name: Fully Autonomous AI Drafting
anti_patterns.why_avoid: Client work requires human judgment - AI should assist, not replace review
anti_patterns.what_instead: AI first draft with mandatory human review and approval

anti_patterns.name: AI Research Before Time Capture
anti_patterns.why_avoid: Time capture has immediate ROI, AI research takes longer to show value
anti_patterns.what_instead: Start with time capture and billing automation, then add research tools

anti_patterns.name: Enterprise Tools for Small Firms
anti_patterns.why_avoid: iManage and NetDocuments are overkill for <20 person firms
anti_patterns.what_instead: Start with Clio/PracticePanther, grow into enterprise tools

quick_wins.name: Dormant client reactivation campaign
quick_wins.impact: Re-engage 5-10 past clients per month, direct revenue from repeat business
quick_wins.how: Export clients inactive 12-24 months, send AI-personalized outreach (regulatory updates, new services, check-in)

not_recommended.name: Full AI document drafting without human review
not_recommended.reason: Professional liability and client duty of care require human judgment on all client deliverables
not_recommended.alternative: Use AI for first drafts with mandatory human review and approval workflow

not_recommended.name: Enterprise document management for small firms
not_recommended.reason: iManage and NetDocuments cost €500-1500/user/month and require IT support; overkill for <20 person firms
not_recommended.alternative: Use practice management systems like Clio or PracticePanther which include document management

not_recommended.name: Building custom billing system
not_recommended.reason: Trust accounting, LEDES billing, and regulatory compliance requirements are complex; rebuilding is expensive
not_recommended.alternative: Use established legal billing tools like Clio, CARET Legal, or TimeSolv

not_recommended.name: AI chatbots for client communication on active matters
not_recommended.reason: Clients expect personalized attention and confidentiality; AI responses risk malpractice issues
not_recommended.alternative: AI for intake and scheduling, human attorneys for substantive client communications
